C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-3-66400CCC.IntentSummary:
This T2 plan converts the approved `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-3-66400CCC` spec into four sequential tasks. It is the first slice of the maintainer-directed split of the monolithic `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-2-C459A20C`; it pays exactly one finding, `F314` (non-exclusive candidate mint acquisition), and it must be independently implementable and verifiable with B2/B3 code absent.
**T-001 — exclusive acquisition and bounded cleanup:** a non-recursive leaf `mkdir` whose `EEXIST` refuses, so losing the existence-check-to-create race writes nothing; a bounded, identity-and-byte-checked cleanup that removes only an invocation-created, invocation-owned leaf and preserves every residue it did not create; the exported self-locking `cleanupCandidate`. **T-002 — candidate-lock cooperation and entry/evidence boundaries:** the tripartite stale-lock reclamation rule, `recordAttempt` snapshot under the lock, the canonical-only WriteEvidence filter, `writePlanNew` live-publisher wait and crash-marker refusal, and `regenerateCursor({apply:true})` entry locking. **T-003 — supersede/review transaction safety and complete writer cooperation:** validate-before-fold for every successor/existence/lineage and predecessor/status/archive/replacement class, rollback and cleanup composition, the three-phase review-verdict snapshot, and the candidate-lock cooperation boundary for the whole covered outer-writer population. **T-004 — operational successor identity and close ratchets:** the scope guard re-authored to the B1 id, the `F314` `bundleMinted` pin introduced naming B1, the single staged `F314` `Owner:` line re-homed, and the successor-owned attribution updates.
**Payment and record writes.** The plan grammar has no `<Pays>` element: the payment semantics live in this `IntentSummary` and in the spec, are carried structurally by the successor-named `registry.xml` charter row's `<Pays>` child (written by the close's `--flush`), are pinned by the `bundleMinted` fixture in `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` (written by T-004), and are stamped as the derived `<PaidBy>` on the retired Finding carrier in `findings-retired.xml` (written by the close's `--retire` after this bundle's archive arrival). `--flush` writes the four live record XML files; an eligible `--retire` writes all seven XML files; neither writer writes `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/decisions.md`, and B1 therefore omits it. The exact non-lifecycle record, source, test, scratch, and already-committed predecessor-transition paths are enumerated in `ObservedWriteScope` — the close's writes are in the plan because the spec assigns them to the close, not to a task.
**Baselines.** `5c7b70caf572470a5ff2da0d73a97b1ef6f771b8` is the spec's whole-bundle byte-invariance base; the activated close-time scope guard compares against it so the already-committed predecessor transition remains in the complete B1 write set. `13e60c68b326e437ccfe6bc2f2090ae4e148da1a` is the clean plan-authoring and task-execution starting point after the approved-spec and supersede stages were committed.
**Gates.** Every task runs its narrow instrument; the full CI-equivalent `bun run validate:ci` is the plan's single `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` and the outer final gate, never a per-task command. The four spec `CloseEvidence` criteria (`AC-NO-UNFORCED-WRITES`, `AC-CLOSE-PAYER`, `AC-CLOSE-LINT`, `AC-CLOSE-TESTS`) are evaluated by the close in the applied-archive state and are deliberately absent from every task's `Satisfies`.

T-001.Title: Exclusive candidate acquisition and bounded cleanup (F314)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Make candidate acquisition exclusive for both `ngrace spec new` and the implicit mint inside `ngrace supersede`: replace the `existsSync`-then-recursive-`mkdirSync` window in `src/grace-generate.ts` (`writeSpecNew`/`publishSpecNew` and the creation-and-publication transaction the wrappers `mintResolvedBundle`/`mintBundle` share) with a non-recursive leaf `mkdir` whose `EEXIST` refuses. Losing the existence-check-to-create race must write nothing: a competitor's `spec.xml` and any foreign file are preserved byte-for-byte. Pre-existing candidates under both `active/` and `archive/` refuse. The spec's `AC-MINT-EXCLUSIVE` (a) and (b) directions are both driven on isolated fixtures, including the baseline control that reproduces the pre-repair overwrite.

Implement bounded cleanup in `src/grace-generate.ts`: remove a candidate directory only when this invocation created it and it holds no artifact this invocation did not write at the moment of removal; validate before the first delete, so a foreign marker or any failed ownership check leaves `spec.xml`, the marker, and the directory byte-identical with `removed=false`. The exact handled boundary is identity mismatch, changed own bytes, foreign entries, an ordinary removal I/O failure, and `rmdir` `ENOTEMPTY`: each preserves the residue and emits exactly one diagnostic naming the directory. A non-cooperating replacement of this invocation's own file between the byte comparison and the `unlink`, and the uncatchable SIGKILL/power-loss window, are outside the supported model and are not asserted safe. The `AC-CLEANUP-BOUNDED` interleavings (a)–(f) and the repetition/new-timestamp rows are driven with the actual `mkdir`/`rmdir`/ `stat` primitives, and the spec's `AC-CLEANUP-VALIDATE-FIRST` row is driven.

Export `cleanupCandidate` as the self-locking destructive boundary: it acquires the documented reentrant candidate lock itself so no caller can invoke it unlocked, and nested calls reuse the reentrancy depth. Land the B1 red-first/green test groups in `src/grace-generate.test.ts`; the criterion is met only when both the pre-repair overwrite control reddens and the repaired exclusive-acquisition and cleanup directions green.

T-002.Title: Candidate-lock cooperation, attempt snapshot, evidence filter, and entry boundaries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Implement the tripartite candidate-lock reclamation rule in `src/grace-cursor.ts`: a parseable known-live holder is never stolen for age (wait for release); a parseable known-dead holder is reclaimed immediately; an empty/unparseable/unknown holder waits for `CANDIDATE_LOCK_TTL_MS`; a token-mismatched release is a no-op that preserves the current holder's bytes. Drive the `AC-CANDIDATE-RECLAIM-EXCLUSIVE` scheduling through the fired seam/barrier: contender B observes the stale token, A reclaims and acquires the replacement lock, then B attempts reclamation from its stale snapshot; assert the callbacks never overlap, A's token and lock bytes survive while A still holds the lock, and B is pending or aborts without removing A's file. Add the mismatched-token no-op control, the own-lock removal control, and the successor-lock preservation control.

Acquire the candidate lock at the approved public entry of `recordAttempt` and snapshot WriteEvidence under it, so a file changed while waiting for a live publisher is included (`AC-ATTEMPT-SNAPSHOT-UNDER-LOCK`). Narrow the WriteEvidence filter to the exact canonical engine path `.ngrace/changes/active/.candidate-<valid C-ID>.lock` and keep every near miss visible: the same basename under the archive, a nested active directory, a malformed candidate id, `src/.candidate-REAL.lock`, and a `.candidate-X.lock` in another top-level directory (`AC-EVIDENCE-FILTER-CANONICAL-ONLY`).

Make `writePlanNew` wait and revalidate for a live publisher and refuse crash marker residue before its first write, with the two reachable rows of `AC-PLAN-NEW-MARKER-REFUSAL`: (a) a real `ngrace spec new` paused after the `spec.xml` write, where `plan new` stays pending and byte-invariant while the publisher holds the lock, then refuses on the draft-spec prerequisite after release, and a retry after approval creates the plan; (b) an approved `spec.xml` beside a stale marker with no live publisher, refused before any `plan.xml` or ledger write. Make `regenerateCursor({apply:true})` acquire at public entry before resolving or reading, driven with the default `allowDirty:false` so the post-lock dirty refusal fires (`AC-REGEN-ENTRY-LOCK`). Land the red-first/green B1 groups in `src/grace-cursor.test.ts`.

T-003.Title: Supersede/review transaction safety and complete outer-writer cooperation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Establish validate-before-fold in `src/gates/ledger.ts`'s `supersedeChangeBundle` and the explicit/implicit replacement handling moved into the transaction boundary in `src/grace-supersede.ts`: all successor existence/location and lineage validation, and predecessor status/archive/replacement validation, run before `discardAndFoldEpoch` and before every other write. Drive the full `AC-SUPERSEDE-VALIDATE-BEFORE-FOLD` matrix (a)–(h) plus the explicit `--replacement` rows (i) and (j) on disposable projects with recursive SHA-256 snapshots and a direct exit, each leaving the ledger byte-identical and every loose file present. `AC-REFUSE-PRESERVES-CANDIDATES` is driven for a pre-existing target directory and for an explicit `--replacement` target.

Compose rollback and cleanup on every post-mint failure: attempt successor cleanup once, record the outcome always, surface the residual-state diagnostic exactly once only when cleanup preserved residue, and never recurse. Drive the exact `AC-SUPERSEDE-ROLLBACK-CLEANUP` red sequence — spec status write succeeds, plan status write fails, spec rollback write fails persistently — and assert the composition of the original failure with the rollback residue, the single cleanup diagnostic, and the predecessor's last-successfully-written state.

Give `recordReviewVerdict` the approved three-phase snapshot: snapshot bundle location, directory identity, and exact prerequisite `spec.xml`/ledger bytes; evaluate CloseEvidence outside the lock; reacquire and compare all of them before rebuilding from fresh ledger state and writing. Drive the four `AC-REVIEW-VERDICT-THREE-PHASE` cases — spec-byte mutation, ledger-byte mutation, same-path directory replacement with byte-identical prerequisites, and active/archive relocation — each refusing with no verdict/ledger write, plus a clean unchanged prerequisite that writes successfully.

Cover the candidate-lock cooperation boundary for the whole outer-writer population named by `AC-COOPERATING-WRITER-COVERAGE`, including the `pauseCursor`/`resumeCursor` aliases and the `mintResolvedBundle`/`mintBundle` wrappers, with the two carved-out reachable discriminators for `cleanupCandidate`; the fold-recovery semantics of `foldEpoch`, `recoverCursor`, and `discardAndFoldEpoch` are B2's and are not asserted here. Land the red-first/green B1 groups in `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` and `src/gates/core.test.ts`.

T-004.Title: Operational successor identity, scope guard, and F314 payer pin

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Carry `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-3-66400CCC` on the operational identity surfaces named by `AC-SUCCESSOR-ID-DATA`: the successor wrapper and path, the successor plan's assertions and commands, the scope guard identity and activation switch, the payer pins and their tests, and the registry row `name`. Historical predecessor lineage and the exact archived predecessor paths remain permitted history; source/test attribution comments assert the current contract as successor ownership and record a measurement as predecessor history. The relation is made mechanically testable, never a blanket textual absence assertion.

Re-author the activated close-time scope guard in `src/artifact/scope.test.ts` to the B1 identity `NGRACE_SCOPE_GUARD_CHANGE=C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-3-66400CCC` and base `5c7b70caf572470a5ff2da0d73a97b1ef6f771b8`. Its allowed set is the four forced source files, the six forced test/ratchet files, the exact four predecessor-transition paths, the exact seven record XML files, the bundle's own active and archive arrival, and the exact `.ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md` transient input — zero globs and no catch-all record-directory prefix, so a planted non-XML file inside `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/` reddens. Drive all six of the spec's `AC-NO-UNFORCED-WRITES` fixtures: clean applied archive passes; a forbidden ordinary path reddens; a planted unlisted file inside the governed record directory reddens; unavailable git evidence refuses rather than reporting clean; the exact predecessor transition is allowed; and without activation a later unrelated change of the same kind does not fail.

Introduce the single `F314` `bundleMinted` pin in `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` naming `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-3-66400CCC` (the clean base has zero `F314` occurrences), and change exactly the single staged `F314` `Owner:` line in `.ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md` from its measured lineage-1 provenance owner `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-1-7D8B2BE8` to the B1 id, changing no other staged owner line. The payer ratchet must be red in the applied-archive fixture when the pin is absent or stale and green only when it names B1; the test reads the durable XML result the flush produces and never the ignored staged buffer, so a staged-buffer edit alone cannot green it. The payment set remains exactly `{F314}`.
